rubric_items.reason: All eleven known REQs (REQ-1..REQ-11) are traced by at least one story; there are no assumed REQs.
Stories are small; S-1 bundles display, order, Status-filter independence and zero counts, broad but coherent.
Previous F-1 resolved: S-2 AC2 puts 01:00 local on 11 March (19:30 UTC on 10 March) outside the range, so a UTC-date filter fails it. Other ACs are Given/When/Then and discriminating.
Counts 4/25/3/2 come from REQ-3's example; 20/21 derive from REQ-10; the UTC+05:30 conversion is derived inline from Asia/Kolkata.
Clear, consistent status terms; S-4 regression ACs still rely on 'as before the change' rather than an observable outcome.
